defects.title: Defect detection
defects.subtitle: Inspection photos: the model marks possible defects, the operator verifies them and rates severity
defects.archived: The mission is archived: photos and findings are read-only.

engine.missingHint: Analysis is unavailable: the app folder needs models/defects/model.onnx and manifest.json. You can still add photos without the model.
engine.failedHint: You can still add and view photos. Try loading the model again.

actions.analyzeAllHint: Only photos not analyzed yet; failed photos are retried one by one
actions.exportPngHint: The photo with boxes at the current threshold and classes, at most 4096 px on the longer side
actions.exportHint: Findings at the current threshold and classes, boxes as fractions of the photo size
actions.gpsAssignHint: Assign the nearest turbine to photos without one that were taken within 300 m of it

drop.title: Drop inspection photos here
drop.hint: …or click “Add photos”. You can select several images at once.

ingest.busy: Wait until the photos already selected are added

turbine.label: Turbine
turbine.noFarm: The mission has no farm — there are no turbines to choose from
turbine.acceptHint: Nearest turbine to where the photo was taken: {{distance}} m

progress.otherMission: Photos of another mission are being analyzed

result.withFailures: Analysis finished. Photos analyzed: {{done}}, failed: {{failed}} — see the reason in the photo strip
result.skipped: Analysis not saved for photos: {{count}} — they were deleted during analysis or the database rejected the record
result.modelMissing: The model is not installed — analysis is impossible
result.crashed: Analysis stopped because of an unexpected error. Photos it did not reach remain unanalyzed.

errors.imageMissing: the image is missing from the database

viewer.imageMissing: The image is missing from the database
viewer.imageBroken: The browser could not display this image
viewer.notAnalyzed: The photo has not been analyzed yet
viewer.zoomHint: Select a finding on the photo or in the table

filters.title: Filter
filters.thresholdHint: Findings are stored from 0.1: the threshold changes without re-running the analysis.
filters.noClasses: Classes appear once the model loads or findings exist

table.title: Findings on the photo
table.empty: No findings at this threshold and classes
table.noneFound: The model found nothing on this photo. That does not mean there are no defects: check the photo yourself.
table.notAnalyzed: The photo has not been analyzed yet
table.failed: Analysis failed — retry it with the button above the photo

confirm.deleteBody: The photo “{{name}}” and its findings will be deleted permanently.
confirm.deleteAllBody: All photos of the mission “{{name}}” and all their findings will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm.retryBody: Findings of the photo “{{name}}” will be replaced: “reviewed” marks and severity edits will be lost.

toast.gpsAssigned: Turbine assigned by GPS for photos: {{count}}

history.hint: All stored model findings, including low-confidence ones (from 0.1). The threshold is applied on the defect detection screen
